description: Directory listing content-addressing + tombstone supersession (SPEC §8.2.1/§8.2.4). listing_id = SHA-256(canonical(content)), where canonical is RFC 8785 (sorted keys, compact) LF-terminated per §0. A tombstone is the SAME d-tag with opted_in=false and optional fields stripped; being addressable (NIP-33) it replaces the prior record. Proves both the content-addressed id and that a tombstone is a distinct, verifiable artifact.
notes: canonical = sorted-key compact JSON + a trailing LF (\n), then SHA-256. The listing and the tombstone share the d-tag (vc07) so the tombstone supersedes the listing at conforming relays; they have DIFFERENT content-addressed ids.
